title: Images Speak Louder than Words: Understanding and Mitigating Bias in Vision-Language Model from a Causal Mediation Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Causal mediation analysis applying interventions (such as replacing gendered words in text and masking faces in images) and measuring the change in the False Positive Rate (FPR) correlation between specific genders and object misclassifications (BIAS_VL metric).
